source: measured transition/animation computed styles + @keyframes CSSOM rules across 34 routes x 3 breakpoints (see extraction/measured-values.json)
globalReducedMotionRule: tokens.css ships a global @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block that forces animation-duration/transition-duration to 0.01ms and scroll-behavior:auto on every element, site-wide. Any section-level motion role documented here must degrade to this baseline, not merely 'disable itself'.
roles: see tokens/10-semantic/motion-roles.json for the full role catalog (11 roles) referenced by typeId from every motion-driven section
durationScale: no formal token scale exists in the source build; measured cluster points are ~150ms (hover), ~200ms (hover elevation), ~300ms (accordion reveal), ~500-800ms (scroll entrances), 1-8s (ambient/decorative loops)

stickyScrollSection.behavior: position:sticky pins an inner visual while sibling feature rows scroll past
stickyScrollSection.reducedMotionFallback: REQUIRED: remove position:sticky, render each feature row with its own static inline visual

carousels.autoAdvance: measured but not user-timed precisely; dot indicator uses carousel.dotPulse (2.4s loop)

decorativeUnhookedFromTokens.halftoneDotPattern: 13,507 circular (radius:50%) elements at --color-blue-400, individually shimmering via scale-pattern-animation-one/-two — the site's signature background motif (see the source build's dot-halftone-*.tsx demo pages). Not exposed as a design token in tokens.css; documented here and in tokens/00-foundation/radius.json.
